name: Rank-2 Nilpotent Matrix Obfuscation
description: Replaced the simple 2x2 elementary matrices with 4x4 dense matrices that are nilpotent of degree 2 and have rank 2. This completely masks the fact that the constraints simplify to s_u != s_v. Because the matrices have rank 2, heuristics like "trace is 0 and rank is 1" fail, and their 4x4 size makes manual evaluation in chain-of-thought extremely prone to arithmetic errors. If the model fails to simplify the matrix math, it will either fail to solve it or write a generic 2-SAT/backtracking solver that TLEs on the lexicographically smallest requirement.
